description: Fork of exp754 (FastMHL hybrid_smooth + dense_K + bf16 storage + master Lion + clip(1.0), final soft=1.1842 @ E=384/dv=64/276.8M). Single change: E 384->192, d_v 64->32 (half width on input embed and value head). Closest references: exp710 (E=192 dv=32 bs=48 16K, TinyMHLut) = 1.2215 with old recipe; exp720 (E=96 dv=16 bs=96 16K pure_soft) = 1.2052 final but +71 mb worse at matched compute. exp755 tests whether narrow-E with today's recipe + hybrid_smooth + dense_K can approach vanilla's exp709 = 1.1922 @ 35.8M at a similar-or-cheaper param footprint (E=192 expected ~140-180M).
